pseudo_code.calculate_commission:
function calculate_commission(buyer_type, block, floor_level, is_garden, is_penthouse, net_price):
    commission_rate = 0
    commission_base = net_price

    IF buyer_type == 'foreign':
        commission_rate = 0.07
        commission_base = net_price - 200000
    ELSE:
        IF block == 'A':
            commission_rate = 0.02
        ELSE IF block == 'B':
            IF is_garden OR is_penthouse:
                commission_rate = 0.03
            ELSE IF floor_level >= 11 AND floor_level <= 19:
                commission_rate = 0.06
            ELSE IF floor_level >= 20 AND floor_level <= 29:
                commission_rate = 0.05
            ELSE IF floor_level >= 30:
                commission_rate = 0.04

    commission = commission_base * commission_rate
    payout_spa = commission * 0.30
    payout_stage2A = commission * 0.70
    RETURN commission, payout_spa, payout_stage2A
pseudo_code.calculate_rebate:
function calculate_rebate(net_price, buyer_is_bumi, unit_type, block, floor_level):
    rebate = 0
    IF buyer_is_bumi:
        rebate += net_price * 0.05
    IF unit_type == 'A1':
        rebate += net_price * 0.09
    ELSE IF unit_type == 'A2':
        rebate += net_price * 0.06
    IF block == 'B':
        IF floor_level >= 11 AND floor_level <= 19:
            rebate += net_price * 0.10
        ELSE IF floor_level >= 20 AND floor_level <= 29:
            rebate += net_price * 0.07
        ELSE IF floor_level >= 30:
            rebate += net_price * 0.06
    RETURN rebate
